request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address for subsequent project-specific administration on behalf of TxPipe
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for year-two maintenance of Cardano's integration standard, including maintainer work, SDK/spec maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for UTxO RPC maintenance, with a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee for a total withdrawal of 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python to standardize interactions with UTxO-based blockchains.
The proposal says UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language-specific SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open source under Apache 2.0.
The work package covers protobuf specification maintenance, SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The requested withdrawal is stated not to breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with administration fees covering oversight costs.

TxPipe is stated to have received 30 Project Catalyst grants from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus prior Intersect open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

Intersect plans to administer withdrawn funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style role approvals, an external Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for year-two UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect, presents the project as open-source developer infrastructure with claimed ecosystem adoption, and describes Intersect voting, NCL compliance, smart-contract administration, oversight, and tracking mechanisms.
